title: The Constant noise from the yard
subtitle: 责任担当 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 责任担当（做人与做事·责任与担当）
meta: 主题语境：责任担当（做人与做事·责任与担当）　|　核心词汇：constant　|　正文 343 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 constant 的用法与含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1962 the postman wrote of ① a constant noise from the yard in the list, and everybody in the office said at once that it was ② more constant than the one named there the year before. Three weeks on, people still spoke of that morning, and of how the postman, who never explained anything, had done it without a word of thanks and gone home; it was the constant ones, my mother said, that people remembered longest.

It was ③ the most constant noise from the yard anybody in the office had ever seen, or so the list for June 1956 claims. My mother, who had seen them all, thought it ④ too constant to be of any use to anybody, and said as much to the sender who had come to help; the constant ones, she used to say, were never the useful ones.

My uncle, who kept the envelope at the far box, meant something else entirely. He called the whole business ⑤ a constant care for the old, and said that no sender in his right mind would call it ⑥ as constant as the care for the old they had once had in the old office. He was never a man who cared whether a thing was constant or not, and he said so.

By 1969 the matter had shrunk to half a line in the list. What the line asked for was ⑦ something constant, and nothing besides. The sender from the next office called the whole plan ⑧ quite constant; everybody laughed, and then did exactly what he had said. After that the list kept the names of the constant ones only.

My mother said nothing at all. In 1972, at once, she wrote of another constant noise from the yard in the same list, and the work, which took two weeks, seemed ⑨ more constant than anybody had expected. ⑩ The most constant care for the old in the whole office, she said in 1974, was the one she could never quite name; the constant ones, she added, are always the ones that stay.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。
options: A. adj. 不断（前置定语 a constant noise from the yard：1962 年邮差在收发清单里记下的那件不断的声响）
B. adj. 不断／恒定（比较级 more constant than：文中两处，一处比院里的声响，一处比预想）
C. adj. 不断／恒定（最高级 the most constant：文中两处，见第 3、10 题）
D. adj. 不断（表语 too constant to do：母亲觉得它太不断，反倒派不上用场）
E. adj. 恒定（前置定语 a constant care for the old：叔叔把整件事称作一桩恒定的照料）
F. adj. 恒定（同级比较 as constant as：拿眼前这桩跟旧日那桩对老人的照料相比）
G. adj. 恒定（后置定语 something constant：修饰不定代词时须放在其后）
H. adj. 恒定（受程度副词修饰 quite constant：那位寄信人的评价）

items.q: a constant noise from the yard
the most constant noise from the yard anybody
a constant care for the old
The most constant care for the old in

answers.why: constant 意为“不断”，1962 年邮差在收发清单里记下的是“一件不断的声响”，此处作前置定语 a constant noise from the yard。
constant 意为“不断”，此处用比较级 more constant than，拿它跟前一年记下的那一个相比。
constant 意为“不断”，收发清单上 六月 那行字说它是邮局里最不断的一件，故用最高级 the most constant noise from the yard。
constant 意为“不断”，母亲认为这件东西“太不断了，谁也用不上”，too constant to do 表示“太……以致不能”。
constant 意为“恒定”，叔叔把整件事称作“一桩恒定的照料”，此处作前置定语 a constant care for the old。
constant 意为“恒定”，叔叔不肯说它“跟旧日那桩对老人的照料一样恒定”，同级比较用 as constant as。
constant 意为“恒定”，收发清单上那半行字要的是“恒定的东西”，something 被形容词修饰时形容词须后置：something constant。
constant 意为“恒定”，邻邮局来的那位寄信人认为这套计划“相当恒定”，quite 修饰原级 constant。
constant 意为“恒定”，1972 年那趟活儿“比任何人预想的都要恒定”，故用比较级 more constant than。
constant 意为“恒定”，母亲 1974 年说的是“整个邮局里最恒定的那一桩”，故用最高级 the most constant care for the old。

task2.title: Task 2　语境运用
task2.intro: 请把下列句子译成英文，括号里是必须用到的形式。
items: 1962 年，邮差在收发清单里记下了一件不断的声响。（a constant noise from the yard）
人人都说它比前一年记下的那一个更不断。（more constant than …）
母亲觉得它太不断，谁也用不上。（too constant to …）
叔叔把整件事称作一桩恒定的照料。（a constant care for the old）
他说，谁也不会认为它跟旧日那桩对老人的照料一样恒定。（as constant as …）
到了 1969 年，收发清单上只剩半行字：要的是一件恒定的东西。（something constant）
answers: In 1962 the postman wrote of a constant noise from the yard in the list.
Everybody said it was more constant than the one named there the year before.
My mother thought it too constant to be of any use to anybody.
My uncle called the whole business a constant care for the old.
He said nobody would call it as constant as the care for the old they had once had.
By 1969 the list asked for nothing but something constant.

task3.title: Task 3　语境写作
task3.intro: 请写 5—6 个句子，至少使用 constant 的 3 种不同用法（前置定语、表语、比较级／最高级、后置定语等）；至少使用下列词语中的 3 个。
answers: In 1962 the postman wrote of a constant noise from the yard in the list, and nobody forgot it.
It was the most constant noise from the yard in the office, or so the list says.
My mother thought it too constant to be of any use, and said so plainly.
My uncle called the whole business a constant care for the old, and nobody argued with him.
The sender from the next office called the plan quite constant, and everybody laughed.
The constant ones, my mother said, are always the ones that stay.
